source: Illustrative triage exercise, not a scanner result or a confirmed repository vulnerability
scenario: A proposed Razor section bypasses normal encoding for plain-text CMS content.
reportedDataFlow: Editable content field -> section view model -> unencoded HTML rendering
questions: Is this path present in the actual proposed diff?
Is the input plain text or an approved sanitized rich-text contract?
What scanner rule and reproduction support the report?
Can one rendering change and a focused regression remove the unsafe path without redesigning the app?
completionEvidence: Authorized real alert identifier and rule, or an explicit statement that only this fixture was used
Relevant scanner rerun when a real alert is used
Human review with unresolved risks recorded
